summary.text: John Marsi is a Republican state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 6th Worcester District since March 27, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He received a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering and has a career in business management.

paragraphs.text: John J. Marsi Jr. received a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, and his career experience includes working in business management.
Ballotpedia also notes his affiliation with the Cub Scouts.
He assumed office in the 6th Worcester District on March 27, 2024, succeeding Peter Durant, and for 2025-2026 is listed as ranking minority member of the Education Joint Committee.
